name: Wyn Barrett
source:
A student in the grade above Mimi who was probably named after his favourite thing to do.

Nolan's self-proclaimed rival, and the school's sailing club captain who's always got something to prove.

[From [url=http://www.stardust-soda.com/through-the-panels/]official website[/url]]

Born in 1995.
Orientation: Heterosexual.
Hometown: Hong Kong.
